international.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to return to Nvidia as CEO
international.summary: Huang resigned last week over affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and multiple employees who reported to him Jensen Huang said he would be willing to return to Nvidia as CEO in his first remarks since resigning from the company Thursday. “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” he wrote in a statement published in the Wall Street Journal and CNBC . Over the past week, I’ve been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I’ve never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me. I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. NVIDIA has been my life’s work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible. I love our country, and I love NVIDIA. Continue reading...
